steps.action: Open the starter board and read the orientation (title, message line, legend, help text, vocabulary on screen).
steps.expected: Board renders with cards, label names the active board, no console or page errors, no blank screen; plain-language orientation is visible.

steps.action: Click every toolbar, inspector, palette, lens and HUD button once and note the visible result.
steps.expected: Every button gives a visible result or a clear message; none crashes, blanks the screen or is unreachable.

steps.action: Build a test board end to end: zoom into an empty card, add 4+ cards, connect 3+ edges, add a note, pin a sample, Save, reload.
steps.expected: The board file appears only once a card is added, holds the cards, edges and note, and survives reload; the parent card links to it.

steps.action: Visual-only edits (drag, resize, recolour, note text), wait for autosave, reload.
steps.expected: Edits autosave with no Save click, persist after reload, wbDirty stays clean, Save does not say deploy needed, active.json is byte-identical.

steps.action: Behaviour edit (rename an action card), then Save, Deploy request, History diff and restore.
steps.expected: Behaviour edit is never autosaved; Save says deploy needed; the dirty pill shows; Deploy request shows the command only; restore brings the old board back; active.json untouched.

steps.action: Zoom through a card with an inner board (wheel or pinch), edit inside, zoom out; zoom into an empty card.
steps.expected: Label flips to the inner board at about half-screen, inner edit saves to the inner board only, zoom out hands back, empty card creates no file until something is added; phone has an Open button backup.

steps.action: Cycle run-mode on every eligible card, try the blocked compile card, the approval gate, the immutable card and the connector container.
steps.expected: Modes cycle inline, background, wait; blocked card says what would need to change; gate/immutable/container never offer background; wire is offered only for allowed tools; run-mode is never autosaved.

steps.action: Repeat c to g on the phone viewport with touch gestures.
steps.expected: Same results by touch; no horizontal page scroll; controls reachable.

steps.action: Abuse: rapid drag during zoom handoff, offline autosave, reload mid-edit, two tabs on one board, unsafe requests.
steps.expected: No crash, no wrong-board write, no silent loss of an edit, unsafe requests refused by the server.

personas.name: Dana
personas.brief: Small-business owner, first-time AI user. 'One fire to the next'; has never mapped a process; handed the starter library. Wants to understand what the board is, drag a library module in, wire two cards, add a sticky note, find what Deploy means. Distrusts jargon (ports, hooks, gates); will click the wrong thing.

personas.name: Erin
personas.brief: Knows the business workflows, not the tech. Wants to recreate a design-asset-to-publish flow, label cards in her own words, add notes for her team, move groups around on a phone, set a card to run in the background. Avoids the terminal; expects things to just save.

personas.name: Frank
personas.brief: Knows business and AI. Builds a board from a module, edits a gate or hook, toggles enforce/observe, requests a deploy, restores from history, zooms through nested boards, sets run-mode on skill cards, and deliberately tries unsafe things (disable an immutable card, background an approval gate, autosave during a zoom handoff).
